correctness.rationale: The monotone threshold equation has a unique rational solution. An explicit probability barycenter of the full Laplacian columns yields the claimed center. Direct squared-distance identities prove all contacts and clearances. The exact weighted variance identity is a global optimality and uniqueness certificate for unrestricted centers. The checker corroborates 646 exact profiles and 23 unrestricted numerical sphere optimizations.

value.rationale: This is the complete exact Euclidean enclosing-ball and contact-orbit classification for all complete multipartite Laplacian simplices, including a sorting-based rational algorithm, screening of entire vertex classes, and boundary contacts of zero barycentric weight.
